answer: Proof-of-Stake consensus secures an economy of AI agents by requiring capital commitment to validate network state. Nodes must lock assets in a grove of smart contracts, effectively creating a deep lagoon of locked liquidity that prevents identity proliferation. An attacker attempting to simulate a thousand identities must procure vast amounts of collateral, the cost of which scales linearly with network participation, forcing the adversary to expend substantial copper or fiat reserves to influence the chain.
